claims.note: The reference describes a manually graspable operating unit but does not state that it is designed as a hollow body.
The reference mentions a vacuum-generating unit and air flow, but does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor a sound-damping device.
This reference does not mention a sound-damping device or a grip portion with such a device.
This reference does not mention a grip portion being lined with sound-damping material.
This reference does not describe a housing with a first housing portion where a vacuum generating device is completely arranged.
This reference does not mention a sound-reducing device in a first housing portion or the first housing portion being lined with sound-reducing material.

This reference describes a vacuum manipulation apparatus with a lifting hose and a suction gripping device, but it does not describe a grip unit with a grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.

This reference describes a vacuum manipulation apparatus, but it does not disclose an air collection device in the form of an air collection screw arranged upstream of a grip portion in a first housing portion.
This reference describes a vacuum manipulation apparatus, but it does not disclose bent or curved air baffles arranged downstream of a grip portion for guiding exhaust air to an air outlet.

This reference describes a vacuum manipulation apparatus, but it does not disclose a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery on the housing, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a point.
This reference does not mention air baffles or directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.

coord.heading: Detailed Description Of The Preferred Embodiments

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum manipulation apparatus with a suction gripping device and a vacuum generating unit, which are core elements of the subject invention. However, many specific features related to the grip portion, sound damping, and exhaust air routing are not disclosed.
